title: A clinical trial applying Regulatory T cells in kidney transplant recipients to investigate the safety and tolerability as an adjunctive therapy to the standard immunosuppressive therapy
official: A Phase I/IIa open label single ascending dose study to investigate the safety and tolerability of regulatory T cells as an adjunctive therapy in deceased-donor kidney recipients - ProTreg
summary: Main objective: Determine whether administering polyclonal ex-vivo expanded autologous Tregs to deceased donor kidney transplant recipients is safe. Investigate if adoptive Treg therapy modulates the immunological response such that the kidney transplant is tolerated and safe. Yield preliminary data that Treg therapy could potentially enable maintenance immunosuppressive therapy tapering or elimination, thereby improving recipients’ long-term prognosis.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Chronic renal insufficiency with a GFR < 15 ml/min x 1.73 m², accepted by the organ transplantation conference, registered by ET (Eurotransplant; www.eurotransplant.org)
2. Age: 18 – 70 years of age
3. Willing and able to participate in the trial
4. Signed and dated written informed consent.* (*For patients unable to read and/or write, an oral informed consent observed by an independent witness is acceptable, if the patient has fully understood the oral information given by the Investigator. The witness should sign the consent form on behalf of the patient.)
5. Haematology: Hb ≥7.0 g/dl; platelets ≥80x10^9/l; total leukocyte count: ≥3.0x10^9/l
6. Karnofsky score: 40 – 90
7. Donor eligibility criteria: Individuals 18 years of age or more are eligible as donors. However, potential donors >50 years will be not eligible if they have more than 2 of the following risk factors; hypertension or serum creatinine >1.5 mg/dl at the time of explantation or an anticipated cold ischemia time of >24 h.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patient has previously received any tissue or organ transplant other than the planned kidney graft
2. Female patients who are breast-feeding
3. All female patients of childbearing age* unless the patient is willing to maintain a highly effective method of birth control** for the duration of the study
4. Known contraindication to protocol-specified treatments / medications
5. AL amyloidosis with significant extrarenal involvement
6. Decompensated cirrhosis
7. Severe irreversible obstructive or restrictive lung disease
8. Severe uncorrectable and symptomatic cardiac disease that is deemed by cardiologists to preclude transplantation
9. Progressive central neurodegenerative disease
10. Psychological, familial, sociological or geographical factors potentially hampering compliance with the study protocol and follow-up visit schedule
11. Any form of drug or alcohol abuse, psychiatric disorder, or other condition that, in the opinion of the Investigator, may invalidate communication with the Investigator and/or designated study personnel
12. HIV-positive or suffering chronic viral hepatitis
13. Patients unable to give their informed consent (e.g. patients under legal guardianship)
14. Patients who are committed to an institution by virtue of an order issued either by the judicial or the administrative authorities
15. Known allergy/hypersensitivity to any component of the study product
16. Positive SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR test
17. Persons who demonstrate dependency from the sponsor, investigator or trial site
18. Panel-reactive antibodies (PRA) grade > 20% within last 6 months before enrolment
19. Previous treatment with any desensitization procedure with or without intravenous immunoglobulin
20. Concomitant malignancy or history of malignancy within 5 years prior to study inclusion in the trial (excluding successfully-treated non-metastatic basal/squamous cell carcinoma of the skin or curatively treated renal cell carcinoma with complete nephrectomy)
21. Evidence of significant local or systemic infection
22. EBV-negative recipient receiving a kidney from an EBV-positive deceased-donor
23. Significant liver disease, defined as persistently elevated AST and/or ALT levels > 2 x ULN (Upper Limit of Normal range)
24. Malignant or pre-malignant haematological conditions. Multiple myeloma, light or heavy chain deposition disease
25. Any uncontrolled medical condition or concurrent disease that could interfere with the study objectives
26. Any condition which, according to the PI, would place the subject at undue risk
27. Ongoing treatment with systemic immunosuppressive drugs at study entry
28. Participation in another clinical trial during the study or within 5 times as the half-life time of the drug used in the previous trial prior to planned study entry
29. Female patients of childbearing age with a positive pregnancy test at enrolment
